content.short: Swarm focuses on pioneering sovereign storage for humanity.
content.description: Swarm operates on the Ethereum blockchain as a decentralized data storage and retrieval network built from a large, interconnected node layer. It interoperates with Ethereum-based protocols that provide payments and domain name services, enabling smooth coordination across ecosystems. The platform stands out for its robust security posture and strong defenses against breaches, helping to protect stored data and ensure resilient access.
